Name: Common Cold
OtcGuidance: Rest and hydration; decongestants or antihistamines for symptom relief

Name: Influenza
OtcGuidance: Rest; fluids; antipyretics for fever reduction

Name: Migraine
OtcGuidance: Rest in a dark room; OTC pain relievers (e.g. ibuprofen)

Name: Allergic Rhinitis
OtcGuidance: Antihistamines for allergy relief

Name: Gastroenteritis
OtcGuidance: Oral rehydration solutions; rest

Name: Minor Burn
OtcGuidance: Cool water running over burn; soothing aloe vera ointment

Name: First Degree Burn
OtcGuidance: Aloe vera gel; mild pain relievers

Name: Major Burn
Symptoms: charred skin;white or leathery skin;large area burn

Name: Toothache
Symptoms: tooth pain;swollen gums;sensitivity to hot or cold
OtcGuidance: OTC pain relievers; cold compress

Name: Dental Abscess
Symptoms: severe tooth pain;fever;swelling in face;foul taste
OtcGuidance: Warm saltwater rinses; pain relievers while awaiting care

Name: Conjunctivitis
OtcGuidance: Artificial tears; cool compress

Name: Corneal Abrasion
Symptoms: eye pain;feeling of grit in eye;tearing;redness
OtcGuidance: Do not rub eye; artificial tears

Name: Pediatric Fever
OtcGuidance: Appropriately dosed pediatric antipyretics (e.g. acetaminophen)

Name: Croup
OtcGuidance: Cool mist humidifier; keep child calm

Name: Broken Arm
Symptoms: visible deformity in arm;severe pain;swelling;inability to move arm
OtcGuidance: Immobilize area; apply ice pack; pain relievers

Name: Sprained Ankle
OtcGuidance: RICE (Rest Ice Compression Elevation); pain relievers

Name: Concussion
OtcGuidance: Rest; avoid screens; monitor closely

Name: Acid Reflux
OtcGuidance: OTC antacids; avoid spicy foods

Name: Tension Headache
OtcGuidance: OTC pain relievers; stress management

Name: Bronchitis
OtcGuidance: Cough suppressants or expectorants; hydration

Name: Sinus Infection
OtcGuidance: Saline nasal spray; decongestants; warm compress

Name: Panic Attack
Symptoms: racing heart;shortness of breath;fear of dying;trembling
OtcGuidance: Deep breathing exercises; grounding techniques
